Unusual spell rules for route planning
The aim of this section is to explain the standard that applies

Companion Animal Travel Desk Operating Standard

This section sets the standard for handling companion animal travel requests at Aurelia Skyways. Staff must prepare each file with careful attention to animal welfare, carrier condition, and the accuracy of passenger details. The safety coordinator reviews hazards and prevention before release, and the ground team moves carriers carefully between services. When Priya Hernandez or Sana Nguyen submits a request, the record must be complete before any handover to the operations area.

At arrival pickup, staff must follow the approved sequence without delay or deviation. <<FACT F095>> The receiving team must confirm the carrier label, inspect for visible damage, and maintain a calm environment during transfer. Any irregular condition, including distress, leak, loose fasteners, or missing identification, must be reported at once and handled under the escalation path. The desk must keep notes clear, factual, and free of casual language.

For check-in concerns, staff must direct the matter through the designated escalation route and keep the traveler informed in plain language. <<FACT F104>> No staff member may improvise a substitute process or promise a remedy outside the approved record. The desk should ensure that carriers, documents, and service notes remain aligned before the file moves forward.

Oversight for arrival pickup remains with the assigned control role, and all staff are expected to cooperate with that direction. <<FACT F101>> Questions about exceptions, welfare concerns, or unresolved handover issues should be raised promptly through the Companion Animal Travel Desk supervisor.
